title: He Never Let the Light Go Out
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When Adam heard the gospel first
The world was fresh and new;
But people slowly walked away
And forgot what was true.

[Chorus]
He never let the light go out,
He never said "the end";
Each time the world forgot His name
He sent it back again.

[Verse 2]
Then Enoch's city grew so good
It lifted up and flew;
And when the flood had washed the earth,
Good Noah heard it too.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
He gave to Abraham His word,
To Moses gave His law;
Then Jesus came Himself to earth,
The greatest gift of all.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
That very light is here for you,
It's shining on your bed;
So rest your head, and sleep, and trust
The words that He has said.

[Chorus]
mood: Rocking music. An unhurried back-and-forth sway in six-eight, like a grandmother's chair moving at the same slow pace it has moved for years. Fingerpicked nylon guitar carries the sway, with one low bass note landing on the first beat of every bar like a promise kept again. The tempo never changes. It grows quieter rather than slower, so the last verse sits barely above a whisper.
